study_identification_part.si_4_title: Predicting Mental and Neurological Illnesses Based on Cerebellar Normative Features

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: The study used Bayesian linear regression with the likelihood warping method, incorporating the sinarcsinh transformation to handle nonlinear basis functions and non-Gaussian predictive distributions. The publicly available cerebellar normative model based on approximately 27,000 individuals without diagnoses was utilized. Scanning site was accounted for as a fixed effect.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: To analyze the data, we utilized Bayesian linear regression with the likelihood warping method, incorporating the sinarcsinsh transformation, to handle nonlinear basis functions and non-Gaussian predictive distributions for large... datasets. Scanning site was accounted for as a fixed effect.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Kim2024.pdf.md: Methods and Materials / Normative Modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: The study used cerebellar lobular volumes (28 lobules segmented by ACAPULCO algorithm) and voxelwise gray matter intensity maps (derived from SUIT toolbox). The lobular features include bilateral lobules I-VI, crus I and II, lobules VIIB, VIIIA, VIIIB, IX-X, vermis VI-X, and corpus medullare. Voxelwise features were summarized using 4 atlases (anatomical 28 ROIs, task-based 10 ROIs, hierarchical 32 ROIs, and resting-state 17 ROIs), computing median, variance, and percentage of extreme deviations for each ROI.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: ACAPULCO segments the cerebellum into 28 cerebellar lobules and computes the volume (mm3) for each lobule... We used Spatially Unbiased Infratentorial Toolbox (SUIT) version 3.4 to segment cerebellar gray and white matter voxel-based morphometry maps... For each ROI delineated by these atlases, we computed 3 key statistics: the median, variance, and percentage of extreme deviations.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: The normative model adjusted for age, sex, and scanning site. Age was used to map developmental and aging trajectories across the lifespan (ages 3 to 85 years). Sex was included as a covariate. Scanning site was accounted for as a fixed effect in the model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: Here, we used this approach to normalize clinical groups against the population reference, accounting for age, sex, and site effects... This normative model includes cerebellar lobules and voxelwise intensities... while adjusting for sex, age, and scanning site... Scanning site was accounted for as a fixed effect.
